resources.string: Identify roadside depots and other locations used in your forestry operation. Keep their field information in a local record.
Record locations and useful worksite directions. A depot can be saved without linking it to a forest or a parcel.
Find the location and directions for each depot. This record identifies a place; it is not an inventory, a reception record or a quotation.
Saved on this device · available offline
Create your first location with a name and depot type. Its position is optional.
A name and type are enough to start. Position and notes are optional. Data stays on this device.
A name easy to find in the field · maximum 200 characters.
Enter a name of 1 to 200 characters.
A depot remains usable without coordinates. A manually entered position is not a GPS measurement.
From −90 to 90 · decimal point or comma.
From −180 to 180 · decimal point or comma.
Enter a valid latitude between −90 and 90.
Enter a valid longitude between −180 and 180.
Previously recorded GPS position preserved without modification.
Access directions, landmarks or remarks · maximum 5,000 characters.
Notes must contain no more than 5,000 characters.
Local space without an account · this device only
Active account\'s personal record · this device only
“%1$s” will be removed from the active list. Its data will be retained locally; this action does not record a wood removal or a zero stock.
The depot record is saved on this device.
The depot was removed from the active list. Its data is retained.
Unsaved changes to this record will be discarded.
The account or its access changed. The record and form were closed to protect each space\'s data.
